_readme: THE SOURCE REGISTER — where a fact about a Chiang Mai or Chiang Rai place can come from,
what each source holds, whether it is the place's OWN voice or somebody's copy, what licence
it carries, and — the part that decides everything — whether we can actually READ it, measured
on a date with a count. Nan, 2026-09-06: 'identify what potential information sources exist and
grow/scale around them. In perpetuity.' The source-scout bot (BOTS.md Tier 0) grows this file:
it adds sources, measures mechanisms, and never marks one 'works' without a yield number.
grade: own-voice (the place wrote it) · official-register (a state list) · directory (someone's
copy of the place) · told-of (a person said). Only own-voice and official-register enter a record
as a fact; directory and told-of enter as leads.
mechanism.status: in-use · works · blocked · partial · to-scout. 'works' and 'partial' carry
measured_on and yield. A source nobody has measured is to-scout, however obvious it looks.
Rules: a source with a licence that forbids reuse is recorded here anyway, with status blocked-
by-licence, so nobody re-discovers it. Nothing here is a scrape policy: Nan, 2026-09-06, 'I don't

facebook-page-via-search.name: Facebook business pages, found through a search engine restricted to facebook.com
facebook-page-via-search.holds: page URL, page name, city line, and the engine's read of the About tab (often hours, address, phone, what they sell)
facebook-page-via-search.licence: the page is the business's public storefront; we record facts, never repost content

mechanism.method: importers/discover_facebook.py --queue → a bot's WebSearch → --deposit → --report. The direct path (html.duckduckgo.com, keyless) is written but answers a self-identified bot UA with a 'select all squares containing a duck' challenge (HTTP 202, measured 2026-09-06) and results only to a browser UA; we do not pretend to be a browser to pass a bot check, so the volume goes through the Opus bot.
mechanism.yield: 10 results per query with a browser UA; via WebSearch 8 hand queries → 46 real CM businesses, 43 not in the catalogue; 1,224-query matrix (both provinces) at 40 per nightly run ≈ 31 nights for a first pass

dbd-juristic-register.name: Department of Business Development — registered juristic persons (บริษัท/หจก.) with registered address and business objective (TSIC code)
dbd-juristic-register.holds: เลขทะเบียน · ชื่อนิติบุคคล (Thai) · วันที่จดทะเบียน · ทุนจดทะเบียน · รหัสวัตถุประสงค์ (TSIC, 5 digits) · วัตถุประสงค์ (the objective written out) · ที่ตั้งสำนักงานใหญ่ (street address) · ตำบล · อำเภอ · จังหวัด · รหัสไปรษณีย์. Eleven fields, and the address ones are filled on every single row.
dbd-juristic-register.licence: Open Data Common (dataset_11_0121). The all-juristic bulk set 'juristic' is Creative Commons Attribution — but see mechanism: its ZIP is a stub.

mechanism.method: Monthly CSV, no key, direct: https://openapi.dbd.go.th/juristic_person/registration/99_YYYYMM_1.csv (Buddhist year, e.g. 99_202607_1.csv = July 2569). data.go.th package_show?id=dataset_11_0121 lists 55 months, 2565-01 through 2569-07; a few older months are served from opendata.dbd.go.th instead and the dissolution file uses .../dissolution/99_YYYYMM_2.csv. REFUSED as a mechanism: the 'juristic' all-companies ZIP (data.go.th 401baf4b…) is 764 bytes and contains only datapackage.json — metadata, no rows; and openapi.dbd.go.th/api/v1/juristic_person/{id} is a one-company-at-a-time lookup, not an enumerator.
mechanism.yield: One month (2569-07): 7,512 rows nationwide, เชียงใหม่ 336, เชียงราย 106. 336/336 CM rows carry street address, tambon, amphoe AND postcode — 100%. CM amphoe spread: เมืองเชียงใหม่ 128, สันทราย 45, สารภี 25, หางดง 24, สันกำแพง 21. Shelf-mappable by TSIC prefix in that one month (CM): shopping 63, food 35, realestate 11, repair 10, beauty+massage 10, medical 10, hotel 9, tours 8. Named examples read off the rows: บจ.อารีย์ ฟิสิโอ คลินิก (86902, ต.สุเทพ) — a physiotherapy clinic, and the physio shelf is EMPTY; บจ.ลูม่า เดนทัล (86203); หจ.ของขวัญ นวดแผนไทย (96101, ต.ท่าศาลา). At ~336 CM + ~106 CR a month, the 55 months on offer are on the order of 18,000 CM and 5,800 CR rows. · SECOND MEASUREMENT 2026-09-20, aimed at the two EMPTY home-services shelves: three months (2568-06/07/08) = 23,471 rows nationwide, 1,156 เชียงใหม่+เชียงราย, of which 27 carry a home-services TSIC — 81210 การบริการทำความสะอาดทั่วไปของตัวอาคาร 10 · 43210 การติดตั้งไฟฟ้า 9 · 43223 ระบบระบายอากาศ/แอร์ 4 · 81293 กำจัดปลวกและแมลง 2 · 95220 ซ่อมเครื่องใช้ในบ้าน 1 · 43299 งานติดตั้งเฉพาะทางอื่น 1. Named examples read off the rows: หจก.นอร์ท คลีนนิ่ง (81210, ต.นางแล, เชียงราย), บจ.พรีเมียมสะอาด (81210), หจก.กฤษณา ริด เทอร์ไมท์ (81293, อ.แม่อาย), หจก.999 วอเทอร์ เซอร์วิส (95220). At ~9 a month the 55-month archive is on the order of 400–500 CM+CR home-services firms.

dbd-juristic-register.trades: every registered company — clinics, salons, shops, restaurants, schools; NOT sole traders
dbd-juristic-register.next: importers/import_dbd.py: walk the 55 monthly URLs into cache/dbd/, keep only จังหวัด in ('จ.เชียงใหม่','จ.เชียงราย'), and map รหัสวัตถุประสงค์ to the shelf tree — 55=hotel, 56=food, 86=medical (86902 physio, 86903 laboratory, 86201/86202 clinic, 86203 dentist), 96101=massage, 96104/96201=beauty, 79=tours, 85=school, 47=shopping, 68=realestate, 45/95=repair. TWO HONESTY GATES: (a) a registered office is where the paperwork lives, not necessarily where the shop stands — the address is a REGISTERED ADDRESS and must be labelled and sourced as one, never printed as 'the shop is here'; (b) a registered company is not an open business — status is not in this file, so every row is a lead until its own voice or a licence confirms it. Pins would come from the tambon centroid or the Longdo geocoder, never invented. Nan's call on both is the fork raised 2026-09-06. ALSO, from the 2026-09-20 measurement: this is the register that fills the two home-services shelves on KNOWN_EMPTY. ('home-services','housekeeper') sat there reading '1 name hit in 24,000' and ('home-services','handyman') reading '46 name hits for รับซ่อม, every one a…' — both true about SHOP NAMES and false about the trade, which registers as a company under 81210 / 81293 / 43210 / 43223 / 95220 rather than putting แม่บ้าน or ช่างซ่อมบ้าน on a sign. Same shape as the WO-22 beauty lesson one layer out: the signal was not on the shopfront, it was on the objective code. Those two KNOWN_EMPTY reasons should be re-read the day import_dbd.py runs, not before.

hss-clinic-licence-register.name: กรมสนับสนุนบริการสุขภาพ (สบส.) — licensed private clinics and hospitals (สถานพยาบาล)
hss-clinic-licence-register.holds: licensed clinic name, licence type (เวชกรรม/ทันตกรรม/กายภาพบำบัด/การพยาบาลและการผดุงครรภ์/แพทย์แผนไทย…), address, licence holder

mechanism.method: TWO things were scouted and neither enumerates a province. (1) hosp.hss.moph.go.th — the สบส. private-healthcare verifier privatehospital.hss.moph.go.th sends you to. It 403s a plain UA and loads in a browser; the form offers exactly two modes, เลขที่ใบอนุญาต or ชื่อสถานพยาบาล. No province filter, no type filter, no browse-all: it CONFIRMS a clinic you can already name, it does not list one. (2) data.go.th org 'hss' (กรมสนับสนุนบริการสุขภาพ) publishes 22 datasets; the only สถานพยาบาล one is dataset-5-1-03 จำนวนสถานพยาบาลเอกชน, a count.
mechanism.status: partial — a verifier, not a register we can read
mechanism.yield: 0 enumerable rows for either province. Denominator found instead: สสจ.เชียงราย (data.go.th dataset50_77) says เชียงราย held 887 clinics of all types in 2568, 797 in 2567. The catalogue holds 0 physio and 23 long-care records across both provinces.

hss-clinic-licence-register.trades: clinics, dentists, physio (the physio shelf is EMPTY), Thai traditional medicine, nursing homes
hss-clinic-licence-register.next: Do NOT build an importer against hosp.hss — it takes a name and gives back one licence. Two live doors instead: (a) DBD TSIC 86xxx rows carry clinic name AND full address (see dbd-juristic-register — 86902 กายภาพบำบัด, 86903 ห้องปฏิบัติการ, 86201/86202 เวชกรรม-เสริมความงาม, 86203 ทันตกรรม), and hosp.hss then VERIFIES each name one at a time as licensed; (b) scout สสจ.เชียงใหม่ (chiangmaihealth.go.th) and สสจ.เชียงราย for a published รายชื่อสถานพยาบาล PDF/XLS — the provinces hold the list the department will only verify. || 2026-09-27: for the LABORATORY child specifically, a third door is measured and works — mtcouncil-lab-accreditation (the Medical Technology Council's accredited-lab table, 49 CM+CR rows).

line-official-account.name: LINE Official Account pages (page.line.me / lin.ee)
line-official-account.holds: Measured, not assumed: the OA display name, a phone, the shop's own status message, a verified badge, and — in the JSON-LD, not in the display fields — the shop's own website via sameAs. The schema also has address, workingTime and budget keys; on the profiles read today they were all null, i.e. the shops had not filled them in.

mechanism.method: TWO HOPS, no key, no session. (1) Resolve the shortlink: GET https://lin.ee/<code> follows to https://line.me/R/ti/p/@<oaid> — that redirect is the only way to turn a lin.ee code into a stable OA id, and the deep link itself carries NO metadata. (2) GET https://page.line.me/<oaid> (no @). A real profile comes back at 80–110 kB with the name in <title> and the fields inside the __NEXT_DATA__ blob plus a JSON-LD block; an OA with no public page returns a ~1.8 kB stub titled just 'LINE', which is how you tell them apart. Extraction caveat for whoever writes the importer: the website is in JSON-LD sameAs and in the account_info_website_link anchor, NOT in the escaped "website" key — my key-based regex reported 0/5 while a by-hand read found one, so trust the anchor.
mechanism.yield: 19 distinct LINE links on disk → 19 distinct OA ids → 5 have a public page.line.me profile (14 are add-friend-only). Of those 5: name 5/5, phone 2/5, own status message 4/5, verified badge 5/5, address 0/5, opening hours 0/5. Named: NewPlus DentalClinic · DEAR HEARING (081-352-8412) · Pet Village & Salon · Eat @ Rincome (052005111) · Yuzu House Chiangmai.

line-official-account.trades: any Thai SME; salons and clinics especially
line-official-account.next: importers/enrich_line.py, alongside enrich_sites.py: for every record already carrying a LINE link, resolve to the OA id, fetch the profile, and write name/phone/website into curated/enrich.json as own-voice with the date. It is a small harvest — 5 profiles from 19 links — but it is the FIRST logged-out own-voice mechanism that returns contact facts at all: the Facebook equivalent gave og:title and nothing else on 0 of 5. The bigger prize is the reverse direction, which is NOT measured yet: whether a shop's OA can be found from its name, rather than only read once a link is already on disk. That is next week's question.

instagram-business.name: Instagram business profiles
instagram-business.holds: Measured, not assumed: og:title (the display name the shop set, plus the handle) and og:description (follower / following / post counts). NOTHING ELSE. biography, business_phone_number, business_address_json, category_name, external_url and is_business_account are all ABSENT from the logged-out HTML — count 0 on every page read.

mechanism.method: GET https://www.instagram.com/<handle>/ with our own User-Agent. No session, no browser impersonation, no challenge. ~700 kB of app shell per profile for two meta tags; the old ?__a=1 JSON endpoint is gone.
mechanism.status: partial — identity only, no contact fact
mechanism.yield: 492 distinct Instagram handles are already on disk across data/canonical + curated/enrich.json. Five read (137pillars_chiangmai · 7sensesgelato · aromashopcnx · artisaninktattoo · Pacharaclinic): 5/5 HTTP 200, 5/5 og:title and og:description, 3/5 a non-empty display name (two shops never set one), 0/5 address, 0/5 phone, 0/5 category, 0/5 bio, 0/5 hours.

instagram-business.next: Do NOT build an enrichment importer against it: it returns nothing data/canonical does not already hold. Its one honest use is confirming that a handle we hold still exists and what the shop currently calls itself — cheap, and the only thing measured. Whether a LOGGED-IN read (the Facebook-about-in-Chrome lane) carries the business fields is untested and is the only version worth another hour. Sample: cache/source_scout/instagram-business/2026-09-20.json

wongnai.name: Wongnai
wongnai.licence: FORBIDS IT. wongnai.com/terms, ข้อห้าม (3): members may not 'รวบรวมข้อมูลร้านค้า ที่อยู่ร้าน รีวิว … เพื่อวัตถุประสงค์ใด ๆ ก็ตาม เว้นแต่จะได้รับอนุญาตจากทางบริษัท' — compiling shop data, addresses or reviews for any purpose without the company's permission. robots.txt disallows only /users/.

mechanism.method: GET https://www.wongnai.com/restaurants/<id> with our own UA → HTTP 200, 336–836 kB, server-rendered; the shop's facts sit in an embedded state blob (contact.address with subDistrict id+name, phoneno, lat/lng, workingHours, priceRange) plus a PostalAddress. The listing API /_api/businesses answers 403. No sitemap (404). Read against the 33 Wongnai links already in our own records, 10 fetched, one at a time, 3 s apart.
mechanism.yield: 10/10 pages read: phone 10/10, tambon 10/10, lat/lng 10/10, hours 10/10 (CM 8, CR 2) — the richest per-page schema of any directory scouted — but the shop's OWN voice is almost absent: own LINE 1/10, own Instagram 1/10, own Facebook 0/10, own website 0/10. The 'a Wongnai page often names the shop's own FB' premise is measured false.

wongnai.next: Nothing, unless Nan answers the 2026-09-27 fork. Its data is exactly what its terms forbid us to compile, and the one legitimate use we had in mind — a pointer to the shop's own page — yields 1 in 10. Do not build an importer. Sample (booleans + tambon only): cache/source_scout/wongnai/2026-09-27.json

lazada-shopee-storefront.name: Lazada / Shopee seller storefronts
lazada-shopee-storefront.holds: seller name, products, prices, ship-from province; usually no shop address
lazada-shopee-storefront.licence: robots.txt: Shopee disallows /shop/*/search and /shop/*/details only; Lazada allows all but login paths.

mechanism.method: Measured against the 175 storefront links already in our records (shopee 132 + shp.ee 11 + lazada 24 + s.lazada 8). Shopee: GET https://shopee.co.th/<handle> 307→200 with our UA, but every shop returns the SAME 202,062-byte SPA shell (byte-identical across three shops; the handle does not even appear in it); /api/v4/shop/get_shop_base answers 403 with error 90309999 — an anti-bot gate we do not dress up to pass. Lazada: /shop/<key>/ and s.lazada shortlinks resolve and answer 200 (~150 kB) with the seller's display name in <title>/og and a sellerKey; no location, no ship-from, no phone, no address in the HTML.
mechanism.status: partial — Lazada gives a seller name, Shopee gives nothing
mechanism.yield: Shopee 3/3 read, 0 facts each (identical shell); Shopee API 0/1 (403). Lazada 3/3 read: seller display name 3/3, location 0/3, phone 0/3. Nothing here we do not already hold.

tat-registered-tour-businesses.name: กรมการท่องเที่ยว (Department of Tourism) — the licensed tour-business register, read through the public licence-lookup's own API
tat-registered-tour-businesses.holds: 35 fields per licence. tour_business_license_no · business_type (ทั่วไป / ในประเทศ / นำเที่ยวจากต่างประเทศ / เฉพาะพื้นที่) · name_th · name_en · issued_date · expired_date · license_status (ปกติ · ยกเลิก · หมดอายุตามกฏหมาย · เพิกถอน · พักใช้) · diving_service · province_name · district_name · subdistrict_name · address_no · moo · soi · road · village_name · building · floor · room_no · postal_code · mobile_no · tel_no · fax · website · email · office · master_branch_main_name. TWO FIELDS ARE A PRIVATE INDIVIDUAL'S AND MUST NEVER BE STORED: identity_no is a 13-digit Thai national ID, and requester_name is a natural person — 1,569 of 2,133 rows in one slice were requester_type=person.
tat-registered-tour-businesses.licence: A public statutory register under พ.ร.บ.ธุรกิจนำเที่ยวและมัคคุเทศก์, published by the department as a public lookup at esvcs.dot.go.th/e-service/LicenseInformationPage. NO reuse terms were found on esvcs or esapi on 2026-09-20 — unknown, and raised as a fork rather than assumed either way.

mechanism.method: POST https://esapi.dot.go.th/api/report/tour-business with JSON body {"full_name":"<substring>"} (the same call the public search box makes; no key, no session, no bot check). The box also accepts {"license_no":"…"} and {"full_name_en":"…"}. full_name is a SUBSTRING match on the trade name, which is what makes it enumerable: a single common Thai character sweeps most of the register. Measured response times 2.0–3.6 s for 20–47 MB. Siblings on the same API, NOT read: /report/guide and /report/tour-leader — those enumerate licensed GUIDES and TOUR LEADERS, who are natural persons, and are refused under the no-private-individual rule. The SPA also calls /old/tour-business-filter2, not measured.
mechanism.yield: Five substring queries (า · ิ · ทัวร์ · ุ · เ) → 5,323 distinct เชียงใหม่/เชียงราย licence records, of which 1,374 are currently ปกติ (CM 1,200 · CR 174); the rest are 3,463 ยกเลิก, 403 expired, 70 revoked, 13 suspended. Field fill on the 2,133-row ทัวร์ slice: name_th 2133/2133 · name_en 2132 · address_no 2133 · tambon 2129 · amphoe 2129 · postcode 2133 · mobile 1742 · landline 1012 · email 1415 · website 275. Active CM amphoe spread: เมืองเชียงใหม่ 639 · สันทราย 116 · สันกำแพง 81 · สารภี 72 · หางดง 72 · ดอยสะเก็ด 53. Whole-normalised-name match of the 1,374 active against data/canonical: 131 hit, 1,243 unmatched. Corroboration: สำนักงานจังหวัดเชียงใหม่ dataset_10_344 puts CM at 1,128 licensed tour businesses in 2567 against our 1,200 active today — the two numbers agree.

tat-registered-tour-businesses.trades: NONE YET — data/categories.json has no tour-agency shelf. The 28 shelves were read on 2026-09-20: the nearest is sights/community (ชุมชนท่องเที่ยว), which is a different thing. 1,374 active licensed operators with an address and a phone have nowhere to land until Nan decides whether a shelf exists. Fork raised 2026-09-20.
tat-registered-tour-businesses.next: Nothing is imported until the shelf question is answered. When it is, importers/import_dot_tour.py: sweep a handful of substrings, keep province_name in (เชียงใหม่, เชียงราย), DROP identity_no and requester_name on read (never write them to disk), keep only license_status == ปกติ as records and file the other 3,949 as history, pin from the tambon centroid or the Longdo geocoder — never invented. The licence number, its type and its expiry date are the own-record fact this shelf would be built on, and no other directory of either province can print them. Cache sample (personal fields stripped): cache/source_scout/tat-registered-tour-businesses/2026-09-20.json

thai-yellow-pages.name: Thailand YellowPages
thai-yellow-pages.holds: Measured on one profile page: business name, หมวดหมู่ (category, empty on the page read), full street address to ตำบล/อำเภอ/จังหวัด + postcode, telephone, fax. No coordinates, no opening hours, and NO JSON-LD anywhere on the page — every fact has to be read out of the rendered Thai text.

mechanism.method: A profile page (https://www.yellowpages.co.th/profile/<thai-slug>-<id>) fetches at HTTP 200, 132 kB, with our own UA. robots.txt permits it: the only relevant Disallow lines are /search/ and /profiles/ (the Drupal code directory, not the listings). Enumeration is the problem, and two doors were measured: /ypsearch?keyword=… 302s back to the home page (the search form needs the site's own JS), and /heading/<Thai category> answers 200 with a province filter and a pager — but the listing rows are rendered client-side, so ZERO /profile/ links are in the HTML. No sitemap.xml (404).
mechanism.status: partial — a profile reads, a listing does not enumerate without a browser

provincial-food-certification-lists.name: Provincial restaurant certification lists — CM Thai SELECT (สำนักงานพาณิชย์จังหวัดเชียงใหม่ _67_69), CM Q Restaurant (สำนักงานเกษตรและสหกรณ์จังหวัดเชียงใหม่ _67_68), CR ร้านอาหารธงฟ้าราคาประหยัด (สำนักงานพาณิชย์จังหวัดเชียงราย dataset40_11)
provincial-food-certification-lists.holds: Thai SELECT: year + restaurant name only. Q Restaurant: year, อำเภอ, name, certification start and end dates. CR ธงฟ้า restaurants: name, operator (a natural person — never stored), อำเภอ, ตำบล, food type, star type, grade A/B.

mechanism.method: CKAN package_show on chiangmai.gdcatalog.go.th (_67_69, _67_68) and chiangrai.gdcatalog.go.th (dataset40_11); one CSV each, no key.
mechanism.yield: 81 named restaurants: CM Thai SELECT 40 (name only, certified 2563→), CM Q Restaurant 7 (with อำเภอ, valid to 2571), CR ธงฟ้าราคาประหยัด 34 (with ตำบล and food type). Small — but each is a state certification that can be printed as a fact on a record we already hold. Clean Food Good Taste (กรมอนามัย) is published as a LIST only by other provinces (ตรัง counts, อยุธยา list); neither CM nor CR portal carries one — 0 hits for 'clean food' on both.

provincial-food-certification-lists.trades: food (all children; CR list carries food type)
provincial-food-certification-lists.next: importers/import_food_certs.py: whole-name match to canonical food records and attach a certification line (Thai SELECT / Q Restaurant / ธงฟ้า, with year and validity) as official-register provenance; unmatched names go to the finder as leads. Next scout step: ask สสจ.เชียงใหม่/เชียงราย whether a Clean Food Good Taste list exists — the national figure is 45,710 certified shops. Sample: cache/source_scout/provincial-food-certification-lists/2026-09-27.json
